method: ENGINEERING native phone action targets and released-last-shot reload. Inventory and actor-free scenes arranged; actual native touches, live frame updates and reloads. No played mission, human ergonomics or performance claim. Baseline mode records the preserved previous build.

checks.name: expanded action targets and compact fallback fit without overlap or text wrapping
released last rifle shot starts reload without a second FIRE press
partial magazines remain manual and exhausted reserves never create rounds
pause freezes reload and resume completes with unchanged ammunition cost
released last breacher shot reloads after pump recovery and spends existing shells only
swapping away cancels the reload and inactive empty weapons do not load in the background
